A '''battle''' occurred on a [[Unidentified war-torn planet|planet]] sometime during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It occurred when the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone armies]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stormed the planet, controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], in order to raid its [[Bank/Legends|banks]] of Separatist treasure. During the battle, [[Wes Apice]] destroyed a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] attacking [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], although not before the clones were wiped out. However, after the cannon's destruction, a [[Unidentified clone trooper commander (bank)|clone trooper commander]] finished up the fighting, and cleaned out the last bank.
